name: suncloudsmoon
description: suncloudsmoon's Claude Code plugins — company personas, a soul-bearing codebase wiki, a ChatGPT deep-research bridge, a prior-art reference harvester, and a tutor for any skill.

plugins.name: company-replicator
plugins.description: Research a company and generate a cited persona skill bundle that makes Claude operate as that company.

plugins.name: stories
plugins.description: A soul-bearing wiki for your codebase — read the stories before non-trivial changes, rewrite them after.

plugins.name: chatgpt-deep-research
plugins.description: Bridge Claude and ChatGPT Deep Research: craft a self-contained prompt, then ingest the returned PDF report.

plugins.name: prior-art
plugins.description: Study how the best already solved it: harvest reference UI into a gitignored .ref/ swipe file, research best-known methods for everything else, and get a copy-this recommendation before building.

plugins.name: wisdom
plugins.description: A tutor for any skill: teaches the why and the mechanism, reads your book, video course or web source before assigning it, schedules practice with FSRS-6, and has you write the core of your own app.
